status: FROZEN for KUN-03 Scientific Conformance Reconciliation (changing any value needs a written reason, QA review and a new profile_version)
claim_boundary: Swiss-on-Swiss integration conformance of the KUN-03 engine against the official swetest CLI for these cases, versions and options. NOT independent astronomical validation, NOT mathematical verification of the algorithms, and NOT historical clock verification. The historical-numerics supplement runs with a test-only gate override and is never production acceptance.

house_reference.engine_call: swe.houses_ex(jd, lat, lon, b"W", swe.FLG_SIDEREAL); Lagna is ascmc[0]
house_reference.reason: The engine's Lagna vehicle is the Swiss whole-sign call. The archival profile used Placidus, whose Ascendant line is identical; the letter is therefore proven separately by the swetest house-system header, the whole-sign cusps and a recorded engine call, never by the Ascendant value.

change.source_milestone: KUN-03 P4 (PR #26, local-date window replaces the UTC-year check) and P8 (PR #28, historical clock gate)
change.reason: Local date 1900-01-01 passes the local-date window even though UTC is 1899-12-31T23:00Z; the pinned Etc/GMT-3 offset +03:00 matches, so the first refusal in P5 order is the historical clock gate. The archival reason (UTC-year check) no longer applies.
